ios.desc:
Airy: Bite-Sized Reflection with Smart Journal

Airy is your personal reflection journal, automatically creating guided-sessions and photo-rich analysis with one click.

Personalized Guided Reflections:
-Airy creates personalized sessions with unique prompts and analysis to help you reflect on your day or moment. From finding photos to checklists, simply talk, let Airy handle the rest.

Effortless Voice Journaling
-Create detailed, photo-rich journal entries using only your voice. Simply talk, and Airy will craft a beautifully organized entry, complete with relevant photos and summaries of your daily activities—from your morning song to your late-night jog. Plus, no media data ever leaves your device.

Automatic Summaries & Analysis
-Airy provides detailed summaries and analyses that span from days to years. Your journal becomes a smart knowledge base of life's moments, capturing everything from dining favorites to mood patterns. Airy automatically pulls in photos, creates summaries, and generates insightful analysis, offering you a complete picture of your day.

Instant Memory Recording
-Never forget a memory again. Just talk to Airy about your memory, and let it handle the remembering and analysis.

Smart Moments
-Choose from summarized moments to get started on your journal. From that morning jog to that late-night song, Airy summarizes it and makes it easy to journal your favorite memories.


Why Choose Airy Journal?
•Guided Reflection: Understand and grow with ease through guiding prompts and analysis.
•Voice-Based Entries: Effortlessly create photo-rich entries by just talking.
•Automatic Photo Matching: Enrich your journal with automatically pulled photos and summaries.
•Privacy First: No media data ever leaves your device, ensuring your personal moments stay private.


Just talk, and let Airy do the rest. Download Airy today.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I'm Steven. As a 4 year journal writer myself, current journal apps are so time-consuming and tedious that it becomes a chore rather than an enjoyment. But I believe most of us want to build a habit of journaling.

So I built Airy, an app that does it for me. (Airy = AI diaRY, lol)

Airy is a smart journal that automatically creates photo-rich journal entries and analysis. Simply talk about your day, or don't, and Airy will automatically create a beautiful journal entry that summarizes everything, including relevant photos, activities, and memories. You can also retrieve any of your past memories or thoughts with a simple question.

Key Features:
-Record: Never forget a memory again. Record any memory instantly with voice, text, or camera.
-Review: Review day, or even year, with one click. All your memory, photos, and activities will be summarized for you.
-Retrieve: From favorite playlists to summaries or your recent inspirations, retrieve any memory with a simple question.

I would love to hear your feedback and thoughts on how we can improve Airy. We are in the beta launch phase, and your input is invaluable to us.

Thank you for checking out Airy!
